# Vendored TabDiff

Source: https://github.com/MinkaiXu/TabDiff (MIT licence, see `LICENSE`).
Commit: `5ecdb3356261aea72716cc9a779f31d7ad083bf4` (2025-06-02).

Only the Python sources, `tabdiff/configs/tabdiff_configs.toml` and `LICENSE` are included; the
example datasets, images and environment files are not. No file has been modified. Every
adaptation needed by SynOmicsBench is applied at run time by
`synomicsbench/synthesizer/TabDiffsynthesizer.py`.
